messages:
maria-finance: Orchid Labs invoice INV-2026-0427 hit autopay but no PO on the PDF. total $12,340. should we hold?

jason-ap: @maria-finance please paste the invoice lines and vendor reference. autopay will attempt to pay tomorrow if not blocked.

maria-finance: ```
INV-2026-0427
1) Managed support (Apr) - $7,200
2) Professional services (setup) - $4,540
3) Hardware rental - $600
Tax: $0
Total: $12,340
```
No PO number on the PDF, just our company name.

priya-purchasing: We have PO-88921 open for Orchid — covers managed support and onboarding up to $11,800. hardware rental wasn't on the PO.

tom-ops: Orchid added hardware rental after we swapped a degraded node. I don't recall an approved change order. @andy-eng did you approve any extra hardware charges?

andy-eng: I did not sign any PO change. That's not approved.

jason-ap: OK — AP will hold autopay for this vendor. @priya-purchasing can you either route approval for the $600 charge or ask them to reissue invoice referencing PO-88921 and remove rental? Per policy invoices must reference PO for payment.

emma-fp&a: FYI holding will delay payment and could trigger late fee per their SLA. but agree hold until PO match or corrected invoice.

maria-finance: I'll escalate to Orchid now. Drafting short dispute note: "Please issue a corrected invoice that references PO-88921 or provide an approved change order for the hardware rental. Payment is on hold until corrected invoice is received."

orchid-accounts: Thanks, Redwood — we received your note. We'll reissue a corrected invoice today as INV-2026-0427A and include PO-88921. If you prefer a signed change order for the hardware rental we can accept that too.

jason-ap: Perfect — when reissued, please send to ap@redwood.com with the PO number in the invoice header. We'll process on the next cycle once PO matches.

priya-purchasing: I'll also generate a change order link in Coupa for the $600 hardware rental in case Andy signs. @andy-eng please review/approve: https://procurement.redwood.internal/co/88921/req

andy-eng: signed the change order. approved the hardware rental as emergency replacement. :thumbsup:

priya-purchasing: Thanks — once we have the signed CO and the corrected invoice referencing PO-88921, AP to release payment.

jason-ap: Marking this thread as: on hold — awaiting corrected invoice (INV-2026-0427A) and change order. I'll set a hold flag in the ERP and cancel autopay for Orchid this cycle.

maria-finance: done. emailed vendor with hold reason and cc'd procurement and AP.

orchid-accounts: Invoice reissued as INV-2026-0427A and includes PO-88921. Thank you for the quick turnaround.

jason-ap: Received, matching now. Will route for final payment next run. Thanks everyone.
file_note: thread about unmatched invoice lines and missing PO for Orchid Labs; hold placed and change order requested
